title_metadata.theme: Design and development of a web application for managing IT support requests and monitoring the computer equipment fleet - Case study: IT Support Service
title_metadata.host_organization: Algerie Telecom - Direction Operationnelle des Telecommunications d'Alger-Centre

abstract_fr: This work focuses on the design and development of a web application dedicated to IT support management and IT asset monitoring. The main objective is to facilitate support ticket management, optimize the tracking of technical interventions, and improve IT equipment monitoring within an organization. In parallel, a mobile application was developed specifically for end users, allowing them to easily create support tickets and track the status of their requests in real time.
abstract_fr_keywords: Assistance informatique, Parc informatique, API, UML, Laravel, Flutter
abstract_en: This project involves the design and development of a web application dedicated to IT support management and IT asset monitoring. The objective is to facilitate ticket management, optimize intervention tracking, and improve equipment monitoring. A mobile application was also developed for end users. The project relies on web APIs and uses Laravel, Flutter, and Filament, following a UML approach.
abstract_en_keywords: IT Support, IT Infrastructure, API, UML, Laravel, Flutter

chapter1.title: Generalities on the Web, Mobile and APIs

sections.title: Presentation of the Web
sections.content: The web is a system of hypertextual documents accessible via Internet. It evolved through several stages and relies on protocols like HTTP and HTTPS.

sections.title: Web Applications
sections.content: A web application is a program accessible via a browser without installation. Client/server architecture with several tiers.

sections.title: APIs
sections.content: An API is a bridge allowing two software applications to communicate. REST APIs, HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

sections.title: Mobile Applications
sections.content: Mobile apps are programs for smartphones and tablets. Three categories: native, hybrid, and PWA.

chapter2.title: Preliminary Study
chapter2.organization_presentation: Algerie Telecom is a public economic company operating in the telecommunications market in Algeria. Created in 2000/2003, it offers voice and data services to residential and professional customers.
chapter2.problem_statement: How to centralize IT support request management and equipment monitoring? How to improve visibility and communication between users and technicians? How to integrate a mobile application?
objectives: Develop a web application to centralize IT support ticketing and computer equipment monitoring
Develop a mobile application synchronized with the web app
chapter2.existing_system_analysis: Current methods: phone and email reports, direct visits to service chief, paper intervention forms, Excel spreadsheet equipment tracking.
existing_system_critique: Work disturbance for the IT service chief
Excel tracking insufficient for real-time monitoring

chapter3.title: Analysis and Design

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: Manages employees, tickets, and computer equipment

actors.name: Technician
actors.description: Lists assigned tickets, updates status, adds comments

actors.name: User
actors.description: Creates tickets via web or mobile application and tracks their status

use_cases.name: Authentication
use_cases.description: The admin or technician enters login information to access the application.
main_flow: If correct, system authenticates the user
use_cases.alternative_flow: Multiple failed attempts temporarily block access (60s).

use_cases.name: Add an Employee
use_cases.description: The admin adds a new employee (user or technician) to the system.
use_cases.postconditions: New employee added with appropriate information.
use_cases.alternative_flow: If role is 'technician', system triggers 'Create Account' use case.

use_cases.name: Create an Account
use_cases.description: A technician account is created with email and password.
use_cases.alternative_flow: If email already exists, error message displayed.

use_cases.name: Assign Tickets
use_cases.description: Admin assigns new support tickets to technicians.
main_flow: Admin selects technician for each ticket
use_cases.alternative_flow: No unassigned tickets: empty state displayed.

use_cases.name: Track Assigned Tickets
use_cases.description: Technician views list of tickets assigned to them.
main_flow: Technician updates status or adds comments

classes.name: Employee
classes.attributes: id, matricule, firstname, lastname, email, phone

classes.name: Ticket
classes.attributes: id, num_ticket, subject, description, status, priority

chapter3.deployment: Web server (Laravel + MySQL) accessed by clients via browser; mobile app via REST API.

languages_and_tools.name: HTML5
languages_and_tools.description: Standard markup language for web pages

interfaces.name: Admin Dashboard
interfaces.description: Main admin interface with statistics and charts

interfaces.name: Employee Management
interfaces.description: List of employees with add/edit/delete operations

interfaces.name: Ticket Management
interfaces.description: All support tickets with status tracking

interfaces.name: User Ticket Creation
interfaces.description: Web interface for creating support tickets

interfaces.name: Mobile App Home
interfaces.description: Mobile interface for creating and tracking tickets

testing.api_tests: Postman: POST request to create ticket, GET request to retrieve ticket details
testing.unit_tests: PHPUnit: UserTicketControllerTest class with 5 tests (creation success, validation failure, valid/invalid tracking, ticket number generation)
testing.performance_tests: Laravel Telescope + custom artisan command simulating 100 POST requests (avg 483ms per request)
testing.mobile_tests: Flutter widget tests for ticket creation screen (5 tests) and ticket tracking screen (5 tests)

conclusion.summary: This project demonstrated the importance of a strong centralized system for IT support management and equipment monitoring. Using Laravel, Flutter, and Filament, the application facilitates ticket creation and tracking, equipment management, and technician coordination. All tests validated the reliability of the system.
conclusion.limitations: The functional scope is currently limited to basic needs. The system is not yet integrated with SNMP protocol or other existing Algérie Telecom platforms.
perspectives: Integrate web app features into the mobile app (equipment management, reports)
Add SNMP protocol for real-time equipment supervision and proactive management
